title: Report to Commissioner Dumas
description: Report to Commissioner Dumas — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Commissioner Dumas

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Return to the office of Commissioner Dumas in Level 2 of MutantMania. Fight past any hazers and find out what the Commissioner wants.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Commissioner Dumas

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The Examinator

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Return to the office of Commissioner Dumas in Level 2 of MutantMania. Fight past any hazers and find out what the Commissioner wants.

Offer:

The rumor mill...Ah say, the rumor mill is a-churnin'. People are saying that you are cheating.

Friend, it looks like Commissioner Dumas wants to put your contract on hold until these rumors can be cleared up. Ah can't, err, Ah mean *we* can't afford to keep you out of the ring.

Get down there and talk to the old coot so we can get back to business! Watch out for those hazers near his office again. They are probably still out to get you after what you did to them last time.

Turn-in:

Good afternoon. It has come to the attention of the Noble Authority of Regional Competitors that you may be violating our competitions rules. We need to address these rumors, forthwith.

Level range: 88–100
